description: Search your decision-memory across ALL tasks — recall a prior decision, fact, or constraint without knowing which task recorded it. Returns the best-matching context entries (key, value, source, and the task they live on) ranked by relevance, with human-stated facts weighted highest. Use at the START of new work to avoid re-deciding something already settled. Lexical match for now (exact-ish terms beat paraphrases). Read-only; scoped to what you can read. Hosted API only.

key.description: Restrict to a specific context key

q.description: What you're about to do or looking for, e.g. 'auth token expiry policy' or 'D1 migration approach'

name: recall
